verdict.rationale: Bruno documents importing existing Postman collections and supports Postman import/export with a preserve-scripts option, so collections can move in both directions with a widely used tool. The evidence for this is thin, though: it consists of a marketing line and release-note entries. missing for 10: evidence of other portable formats (e.g. OpenAPI, Insomnia, HAR), dedicated first-party import/export documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of round-trip fidelity.
